valueProps.sectionTitle: Why Saudi Industrial Contractors Choose RopeLink
valueProps.sectionSubtitle: Enterprise-grade digital infrastructure built for zero idle time, verified credentials, and frictionless B2B mobilization.
valueProps.card1Desc: Prevent technician downtime between turnarounds. Sublease certified crews to trusted contractors and maintain continuous revenue.
valueProps.card2Desc: Bypass sluggish traditional recruitment. Secure certified teams in Jubail, Yanbu, and NEOM in under 48 hours.
valueProps.card3Desc: All crews are pre-vetted with active licenses (IRATA L1/L2/L3, NDT Level II, and Aramco/SABIC safety compliance).

howItWorks.title: How RopeLink Works for Contractors
howItWorks.subtitle: Streamlined steps connecting industrial demand with certified supply across the Kingdom.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Specify required trades, IRATA levels, headcount, location, and dates in under 60 seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our engine pairs available certified manpower with contractors based on proximity, credentials, and timeline.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Sign standard B2B sublease agreements and deploy certified crews on-site with full HSE compliance.

agreements.termsTitle: Standard B2B Manpower Terms & HSE Covenants
agreements.termsClause1: 1. Manpower provider warrants that all deployed technicians hold valid IRATA/trade certifications.
agreements.termsClause2: 2. Both parties agree to execute official Ajeer Temporary Work Permits and facility gate passes prior to mobilization.
agreements.termsClause3: 3. Strict adherence to host site Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) protocols and Saudi Labor Law.
agreements.acceptTermsLabel: I accept the standard B2B terms and certify all provided enterprise details
agreements.signModalDesc: By confirming, a cryptographic digital signature stamp will be recorded with your organization's ID and timestamp.

mobilization.stage7Desc: Scope executed, site handed over, and contract closed
